title: A Model with No Head and Many Thoughts
abstract: arXiv:2608.31069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models decode by projecting hidden states through a large vocabulary head at every step. This operation is computationally costly and forces all reasoning to be expressed in discrete tokens. We introduce Soft Latent Thinking, a method that replaces the LM head during reasoning with a lightweight projector, enabling autoregressive rollout in embedding space where reasoning steps remain continuous rather than tokenized. Experiments on DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B and LLaMA-3.2-3B show that Soft Latent Thinking consistently improves pass@k across all k while reducing per-step compute during chain-of-thought. Our method achieves the highest pass@32 among all soft-thinking approaches, demonstrating that effective reasoning can be carried out in continuous space without discrete token generation.

translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在每一步解码时，都需要将隐藏状态通过一个巨大的词表输出头进行投影。这一操作计算成本高昂，并且迫使所有推理都必须以离散词元的形式表达。我们提出了软潜在思维，该方法在推理阶段用一个轻量级投影器取代语言模型输出头，使得自回归展开可以在嵌入空间中进行，推理步骤保持连续而无需词元化。在 DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B 和 LLaMA-3.2-3B 上的实验表明，软潜在思维在所有 k 值下都能持续提升 pass@k 指标，同时降低了思维链推理过程中每一步的计算量。我们的方法在所有软思维方法中取得了最高的 pass@32 成绩，证明有效的推理可以在连续空间中进行，而无需生成离散词元。
tldr: 提出软潜在思维方法，在推理时用轻量级投影器取代语言模型输出头，使推理在连续嵌入空间中自回归展开，在所有 k 值下提升 pass@k 性能的同时降低每步计算成本。
en_tdlr: Soft Latent Thinking replaces the LM head with a lightweight projector during reasoning, enabling continuous autoregressive rollout in embedding space that improves pass@k across all k while reducing per-step compute.
